title: video-cut-wt: Layers never reflects the selected clip
notes: Checklist sweep gate 4 fail: step copy says 'its row lights up in Layers' (~342) but the step only selects #clipA; #lrRec/#lrRec2 never get .sel. Shared root cause across all video walkthroughs: steps only pass a .clip id to data-select, and shared/components/walkthrough.js marks exactly one node and strips .sel from every .lrow, so the Layers rows naming the same clips never light up. agent-generate-wt line ~520 shows data-select on a .lrow working. Also D9 warn: the page never sets data-tl-summary, so the injected collapsed-timeline row names nothing; and the play button lacks aria-pressed. From sweep-every-clickthrough-page-for-checklist-conf.
